Ruling: batch #264 item 5 · letter C · maintainer 「同意264」 2026-10-01T23:07Z

Director seat, summon #32, objectstack-ai/objectstack `session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`. Written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay.
- **How it was ruled.** Batch #264 was presented in the live director chat with this card's options A–D. The director recommended **C**, fallback B, and said explicitly that C reverses objectstack#5428 item 4. The maintainer answered the batch as presented: 「同意264」.
- **Freshness gate:** no comment on this card.

## The ruling

**C: retire the metric sub-caption at both ends, objectstack first.**
- This **reverses objectstack#5428 item 4** (2026-08-06, 「two authored fields, two keys」).
- A widget keeps one authored description, `widget.description`, still rendered as the card-header subtitle.
- If a named user later asks for a caption under a metric's value, it returns as a declared widget-level key outside `options` (B). It never returns as `options.description`.
- **Not taken:**
  - A: declare `options.description`, which leaves two authorable `description`s on one widget.
  - B: a new declared home, which changes the spec for a capability with zero producers.
  - D: the status quo, where the platform's own output fails its strict face.

## Readings

- Zero authored writers of `options.description`, and zero `subCaption` bundle entries, in either repository (objectui#11070 round 11, dev report 5934110109).
- The only writer is objectstack's own `translateDashboard` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:1590`–`:1593` at `main` `434c6c7cab`).
- **Prior rulings read:** objectstack#5428 item 4 (reversed here); objectstack#7862; objectui#11228 ruling C.

## 四棱(本裁决新记录)

- ① 长远:一个卡片一个 `description`,特例最少;将来真有拉动,以 B 的形态(`options` 之外的声明键)回来。
- ② 拉动:零作者写入、零翻译条目(实测)。
- ③ 防 AI:两个 `description` 正是 AI 易混处,C 最紧。
- ④ 不扩散:已发布零消费能力,不因沉没成本豁免。
- 只看①选 C;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

## Execution parameters (ruled here; no further decision card)

- **objectstack first:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#21257 (`domain:spec`, `pm:queue`).
  - It retires the `subCaption` translation member (a tombstone, plus the alias removed).
  - It removes `translateDashboard`'s `options.description` overlay and drops the census row.
  - Changeset `minor` with BREAKING, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; contract review at tier.
- **This card** becomes the objectui half: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` on objectstack#21257 in this act.
  - Its scope: drop every read of `options.description` as a sub-caption, in `DatasetWidget`, `widgetSubCaption` limb 1, and `DashboardRenderer`'s inline arms.
  - Pins: a metric tile renders no sub-caption from `options`, and `widget.description` still renders as the header subtitle.
  - The unlock: objectstack#21257 closing, read by its content on objectstack `main`. The objectui change does not need the new spec installed, because it only stops reading a key. The unlock-time check states whether the pin moved anyway.

Restart-when: an `@objectstack/spec` release that carries `99e1912afc` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21342) is published on npm, and objectui resolves it. 17.6.0 does not (read at this write).

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21257 closed `completed` at 2026-10-02T06:45Z, landed by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21342 as `99e1912afc`. The cross-repo unlock keys on the install face, as the holder's pointer above (`5946940099`) says.
- `99e1912afc` landed after the 17.6.0 tag (`617f25f8a4`), so the next spec release carries it. objectui#11438, the 17.6.0 bump, does not.
- At the restart, the pointer's probe runs first: the installed spec refuses the retired key by name, and the sdui-parser consumed-keys set has no `description`.

## Triage: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. Both halves of this card's `Restart-when:` are met: a published `@objectstack/*` release carries `99e1912afc`, and objectui now resolves it

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T02:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Read at this write:**
- **The release half:** `99e1912afc` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21342) is an ancestor of the 17.7.0 tag `4e4e881427` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`). 17.7.0 has been on npm since 2026-10-06.
- **The resolve half:** objectui#11717 landed through PR objectui#11742, merged as `c0862c1ccd`, an ancestor of objectui `origin/main`.
  - `pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`;
  - `packages/types/package.json` declares `^17.7.0`.
- **The bump did not do this card's work.** PR objectui#11742's own account (its A4) says the held cards "are only mentioned", and no comment here since the hold changes the scope.

The card's grade and its scope stand as written. The claimant re-reads the hold comment and builds against 17.7.0. Where a package needs a 17.7.0-only export, its floor is already `^17.7.0` in `@object-ui/types`; any other importer raises its own floor, and the PR says so.
